units.source_text: 柏木心中恼乱，忍受不住，未曾终宴先告辞了。

en.t: Kashiwagi was so troubled at heart that he could not endure it, and before the banquet ended he took his leave.

units.source_text: 回家之后，身体一直不好，想道：“我今天并不曾像往常那样喝得大醉，何以如此痛苦呢？

en.t: After returning home, he continued to feel unwell and thought, "I did not drink heavily today as I usually do, so why am I suffering like this?

units.source_text: 大概是由于良心苛责，所以弄得头昏眼花吧？

en.t: Perhaps my conscience is tormenting me, and that is why my head swims and my eyes blur?

units.source_text: 我自己觉得向来并不如此怯弱呢。

en.t: I have always thought that I was not this timid.

units.source_text: 真是太不中用了！”

en.t: How utterly useless I have become!"

units.source_text: 他自己可怜自己。

en.t: He pitied himself.

units.source_text: 但这不是一时的酒醉，柏木从此生起大病来了。

en.t: But this was not a passing drunken spell; from then on Kashiwagi fell gravely ill.

units.source_text: 父亲前太政大臣和母夫人都很着急。

en.t: His father, the former Grand Minister, and his mother were both deeply anxious.

units.source_text: 他住在落叶公主那边，父母很不放心，要他迁回大臣邸内来养病。

en.t: Since he was staying with Princess Ochiba, his parents were uneasy and wanted him moved back to the minister's residence to recover.

units.source_text: 但是落叶公主舍不得他，样子又很可怜。

en.t: But Princess Ochiba could not bear to part with him, and her appearance was pitiful.

units.source_text: 在以前太平无事之时，柏木对于夫妻之情漠不关心，以为将来总会好转，所以并不十分爱她。

en.t: In earlier, peaceful days, Kashiwagi had been indifferent to conjugal affection, thinking things would improve in time, and so he had not loved her very deeply.

units.source_text: 但是此次要他迁走，他忽然担心起来：这一别不成为永诀么？

en.t: But now that he was being made to move away, he suddenly grew anxious: might this parting become a final farewell?

units.source_text: 心中异常悲伤。

en.t: His heart was filled with extraordinary sorrow.

units.source_text: 把落叶公主抛弃在这里，让她独自悲叹，又觉得很对她不起，因此越发痛心。

en.t: Leaving Princess Ochiba behind here to grieve alone seemed terribly unfair to her, and this made his pain still greater.

units.source_text: 落叶公主的母亲也很悲伤，她对柏木言道：“世事都有惯例：与父母不妨别居，夫妻则无论何时决不分离，向来都是如此。

en.t: Princess Ochiba's mother was also deeply saddened, and she said to Kashiwagi, "There are customs in this world: one may live apart from one's parents, but husband and wife are never to be separated, no matter when; it has always been so.

units.source_text: 如今把你们两人拆散，直到你病愈为止，这期间实在教人担心。

en.t: To separate the two of you now until your illness is cured is truly a cause for worry.

units.source_text: 我劝你暂时在此间养病吧。”

en.t: I urge you to remain here for the time being and recover."

units.source_text: 便在自己身边张个帷屏，亲自看护他。

en.t: She then set up a curtain screen beside herself and personally nursed him.

units.source_text: 柏木答道：“尊意诚属有理。

en.t: Kashiwagi replied, "Your words are entirely reasonable.

units.source_text: 我身微不足数，其实不配高攀。

en.t: I am a person of low standing and little worth, and in truth I was not fit to aspire so high.

units.source_text: 猥蒙公主下嫁，衷心感激。

en.t: That the princess graciously lowered herself to marry me fills me with heartfelt gratitude.

units.source_text: 为欲表示答谢，但望此生长寿，教公主看我这小小前程逐渐晋升。

en.t: To show my thanks, I only wished to live long enough for the princess to see my modest prospects gradually rise.

units.source_text: 不料现在竟患如此重病，深恐连这一点愿望也不能达成，言念及此，自伤命蹇，但觉死也不能瞑目。”

en.t: Unexpectedly, I have now fallen so gravely ill, and I fear that even this small wish cannot be fulfilled; when I think of it, I lament my ill fate and feel that I could not close my eyes in death."

units.source_text: 说罢，两人相向而哭。

en.t: When he had finished speaking, the two faced each other and wept.

units.source_text: 他不想立刻迁居父母家去。

en.t: He did not want to move at once to his parents' home.

units.source_text: 但母夫人也不放心起来，派人对他说道：“你怎么不想先见父母呢？

en.t: But his mother also grew uneasy and sent someone to say to him, "Why do you not first wish to see your parents?

units.source_text: 我每逢身体略有不适、心情沉闷无聊之时，在许多子女之中，总首先想见见你，见了你便觉安心。

en.t: Whenever I feel even slightly unwell, or when my heart is gloomy and listless, among all my many children it is always you I first want to see, and seeing you puts me at ease.

units.source_text: 如今叫我大失所望了！”

en.t: Now you have left me deeply disappointed!"

units.source_text: 母夫人的怨恨亦属有理。

en.t: His mother's resentment was also understandable.

units.source_text: 柏木便对落叶公主说道：“大约是由于我比诸弟先出世之故吧，父母对我一向特别重视。

en.t: Kashiwagi then said to Princess Ochiba, "Perhaps because I was born before my younger brothers, my parents have always valued me especially highly.

units.source_text: 现在还是很怜爱我，暂时不见就要挂念。

en.t: Even now they are very fond of me, and if they do not see me for a short while, they become worried.

units.source_text: 因此我今到了大限将临之时，若不与父母相见，我的罪孽深重，死后也不能安心。

en.t: Therefore, now that the end of my life seems near, if I do not see my parents, my guilt will be heavy and I will have no peace even after death.

units.source_text: 故我只得迁去。

en.t: So I have no choice but to move there.

units.source_text: 你倘闻知我病濒危，务望悄悄地前来探望，我们必能相见。

en.t: If you hear that my illness has become critical, please come quietly to visit me, and we will surely be able to meet.

units.source_text: 我的本性异常愚痴，凡事都有疏忽不周之处，思之实甚悔恨！

en.t: By nature I am extremely foolish, and in everything I have been careless and inadequate; when I think of it, I am truly filled with regret!

units.source_text: 我想不到自己如此短命，一向总以为来日方长呢。”

en.t: I never imagined that my life would be so short; I always thought there would be many days ahead."

units.source_text: 便啼啼哭哭地迁居父母邸内。

en.t: Then, weeping bitterly, he moved into his parents' residence.

units.source_text: 落叶公主独留自宅，不堪想念之苦。

en.t: Princess Ochiba remained alone in her own home, unable to bear the anguish of longing for him.
